{{Quote|We figured we'd take a shortcut throug Desolation Canyons.''"<br />"''Wouldn't recommend that. Might run into Sand People.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Douz outpost mechanic|<ref name="LCOT" />}}
The '''Desolation Canyons''' were a system of narrow valleys cut in rock, located on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]&mdash;a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Canyons were located midway between the [[Douz outpost]] and the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Metameur]]. It was home to a tribe of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].<ref name="LCOT" />
